item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (335 Berry St): In October 2008 SocketSite reported that applications…
item.description: In October 2008 SocketSite reported that applications were open for the 131 below-market-rate condos that "will compose Mission Walk (330/335 Berry Street)", with a lottery set for January 28, 2009. The post says the site "might still be wrapped in scaffolding" and does not say how far construction had gone. Source: https://socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (335 Berry St): The record said Mission Walk was built under the San…
item.description: The record said Mission Walk was built under the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency's Affordable Homeownership Program and that its below-market units were allocated by a lottery in January 2009. Neither cited source says the first, and SocketSite (2008) only announced the lottery for January 28, 2009, so the summary now says that. A 2023 city memo listing Mission Walk as 131 family for-sale affordable units completed in 2009 is now cited. The map notes said the opening year and unit count were unconfirmed; they now state the 2009 build year (Assessor and Condo Market SF) and that the unit count for this address alone is unsettled. The aerial photo credit names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per its user page) and drops the unsupported 'departing flight' wording. Source: SocketSite, 2008-10-27 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html); SF Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development, 400 China Basin gap-funding memo, 2023-10-20 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/Approved_400_China_Basin_Additional_Gap_Funding_-_LC_10-20-23.pdf); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 335 Berry St (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8707&lot=120); San Francisco Condo Market, 335 Berry St (https://www.sanfranciscocondomarket.com/building/335-berry-st); Wikimedia Commons, User:Firstcultural (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Firstcultural).
